$comment: Etsy listing handle -> Shopify product handle, for scripts/import-etsy-reviews.ts. Only listings that are the same product belong here: a match puts the review on that product page and in its rating. Any Etsy handle left out is imported under its Etsy listing and appears only in the shop-wide review feed and home showcase. Handles alone are not proof: Etsy's i-heart-ry-shirt is the white shirt, while Shopify's i-heart-ry-shirt is the black one.
